extension_description.message: 🎥 Never change playback speed again — set a default speed for every YouTuber & Bilibili creator.

settings_lede.message: Map keys to speeds, and choose automatic defaults for the videos you watch.

shortcuts_hint.message: Works on videos across the web when you’re not typing.

shortcut_conflict_body.message: If you use Vimium or another keyboard-navigation extension, add this rule under Excluded URLs and keys so these shortcuts reach the video.

priority_tooltip_body.message: Priority: manual speed > channel setting > custom webpage prefix > platform fallback.

url_defaults_hint.message: The longest matching URL prefix wins.

creator_defaults_hint.message: Applied when a channel’s video loads. Easiest to set from the icon in the top-right corner.

no_creator_defaults_body.message: On a YouTube or Bilibili video, open the extension popup and set a default — or add one manually.

creator_lookup_failed.message: Couldn’t load nickname. You can still save this creator.

error_shortcut_missing.message: Choose a shortcut for every row.

error_shortcut_duplicate.message: Each shortcut can only be used once.

error_fallback_speed_range.message: Fallback speed must be blank or between 0.25× and 16×.

error_url_prefix_invalid.message: Enter a full HTTP or HTTPS URL for every webpage prefix.

error_url_prefix_duplicate.message: Each webpage prefix can only be used once.

error_url_speed_range.message: Webpage-prefix speed must be between 0.25× and 16×.

error_creator_invalid.message: Use a YouTube channel URL, @handle, channel ID, or a Bilibili space URL/UID.

error_creator_duplicate.message: Each creator can only have one default speed.

error_creator_speed_range.message: Creator speed must be between 0.25× and 16×.

creator_change_note.message: Changes apply to this video now and to future videos from this creator.

open_supported_video.message: Open a YouTube or Bilibili video.

popup_recognition_hint.message: The popup will recognize the channel automatically.

automatic_speed_hint.message: Rules match from most specific to platform default and apply once per video.

compatibility_hint.message: Only adjust this when another extension intercepts your shortcuts.

project_hint.message: Explore the source code or tell us what could work better.

feedback_hint.message: Report a bug or suggest an improvement on Issues

creator_defaults_compact_hint.message: $COUNT$ saved rules; adding from the extension popup is usually fastest.

finish_creator_edit.message: Finish or cancel the channel being edited.

unsaved_changes.message: Changes are not saved yet and will sync to Chrome.
